question: Which year census is the 15th National census survey conducted by the Census Organisation of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2011.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **15th National census survey** was conducted by the** Census Organisation of India** in the year **2011.**
 
• The main aim of the census survey is to collect **demographic and socio-economic data **of the population of India.
 
• The census helps in the allocation of **resources and planning of government policies.**
 
• The 2011 census was the largest census survey ever conducted in the history of India, covering a population of over **1.2 billion people.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1991** was the 13th National census survey.
 
• **2001** was the 14th National census survey
 
• **1981** was the 12th National census survey.
 
• The process of methodically **gathering, documenting, and computing** population data about the individuals within a specific population is known as a census.
 
• **Henry Walter **conducted the** first known citizen census** in **Daac (Dhaka) in 1830.**
 
• Henry Walter is regarded as the **father of the Indian Census** as a result.
